title: ProfileService ignores RequestedClaimTypes and emits payment-card data (incl. CVV) into every token
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka; component: Identity.API/
rationale: Removes the four payment-card claim emissions (card_number, card_holder, card_security_number, card_expiration) at their sole source in GetClaimsFromUser and honors context.RequestedClaimTypes in GetProfileDataAsync per the Duende contract. No API consumes card claims from tokens; MAUI checkout autofill degrades to nulls (functional follow-up, zero security impact).
variants_checked: Single IProfileService implementation; grep confirms ProfileService.cs is the only producer of card_* claims; consumers only via ClientApp userinfo (covered by source removal); Config.cs flags intentionally untouched.
bypass_considered: userinfo, requested-claim filtering, AlwaysIncludeUserClaimsInIdToken, and token reissue all cannot emit card claims after the source removal; only pre-existing tokens remain valid until expiry (rotate at deploy).
test_note: New tests/Application.UnitTests/ProfileServiceTests.cs: unrestricted profile yields no card_* claims; requested-claim filter returns exactly the intersection.
review_reason: Root-cause removal of CVV/PAN emission at the sole producer plus the Duende RequestedClaimTypes contract; filter can only narrow; additive tests follow repo conventions.
